_comment: Representative decompositions for test domains. These stand in for OpenAI output so the pipeline can be tested across domains without credits or network. Shape is identical to what decompose.py emits.

camping.label: shelter for five people
camping.rationale: Five people need to sleep out of the rain; this is the one thing the trip fails without.

camping.label: stay warm overnight
camping.rationale: Nights drop below comfortable even in summer, and nobody sleeps through cold.

camping.label: cook hot food
camping.rationale: A hot meal is the difference between camping and enduring.

camping.label: see after dark
camping.rationale: Sunset is earlier than people plan for, and cooking in the dark is miserable.

dinner.label: somewhere for twelve people to sit
dinner.rationale: Twelve guests need seating; without it the dinner doesn't happen.

dinner.label: cook for a crowd
dinner.rationale: Cooking for twelve needs volume a weeknight pan can't handle.

dinner.label: serve twelve people
dinner.rationale: Everyone needs something to eat off, ideally not disposable.

dinner.label: keep food and drinks cold
dinner.rationale: Fridge space runs out fast when cooking for twelve.
